versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the huawei-cloud-flexus-l-deploy-jiuwenswarm skill.
- Enables one-click automated deployment of JiuwenSwarm (or JiuwenClaw) on Huawei Cloud Flexus L instances.
- Supports seamless instance creation, application installation via Huawei COC, model API, and message channel (Xiaoyi, Feishu, DingTalk) configuration.
- Strict security execution rules: credentials are never exposed or requested interactively; all scripts run via controlled mechanisms.
- Provides clear workflow guidance, environment and resource requirements, and prerequisite instructions for smooth deployment.
